# Abyssal razor

Internal ID: KnifeChitin | Type: Knife | Source: Workbench | Usage: Weapon | Wielding: One-handed | Crafting Materials: Chitin x30 | Attack speed: 1.52 s | Chain last hit: 2x damage, +20% knockback | Hitbox: 1.8 range, 45 angle, 0.5 height, 0.3 ray

# Introduction

The Abyssal razor is the third knife. Its primary attack is a 3-hit attack combo with double damage on the last hit. Its secondary attack is a forward leap with 3x damage.
It deals 6x damage against enemies that have not been alerted.
